title: Esses key bindings (keymap-1)
description: Key bindings (06 section 14.3): the shipped data/keymaps/default.json (every row of the 06 section 14.4 table with status, milestone and doc; inherits null) and the per-user <config>/keymap.json (inherits "default"; it adds, replaces or unbinds rows). Rows are identified by (command, context, args). Two rows binding the same key sequence in one context are a conflict, reported and disabled at load (06 section 14.2 rule 7). Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved; rows are closed.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

inherits.description: The keymap this one modifies ("default"), null for a complete keymap.

unbind.description: Inherited rows removed, by command and context.

binding.description: One binding row (06 section 14.3). status, milestone and doc are carried by the shipped default on every row and ignored in user files; a planned or implemented row names its milestone.

keys.description: Qt portable-text key sequences; empty for menu-only commands.

doc.description: One-line behaviour text for the palette tooltip and the generated docs.

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
